authority: explicit user instructions, generalized for shared playbook, 03/10/2026

narration.vo_source: use selected supplied VO; generate only if needed
narration.generation: one continuous master from full script

editor.name: DaVinci Resolve
editor.bridge_expected: needed only from stage 04 (after 03 passes); verify live then
editor.resolve_connect_from_stage: 04; stages 00-03 never require Resolve/MCP; exception: existing timeline or timeline-only task

picture.share_scope: video first according to each clause; still only when matching video unavailable
picture.chapter_all_stills_allowed: only when matching video unavailable and documented
picture.ai_image_prep: ver 32: off-ratio images -> AI expand or regenerate to 16:9 (detail changes allowed, no factual match required); low-quality images only -> AI enhance (4K not required, tool default size OK); 16:9 and sharp images used directly; mark ai_regenerated in internal ledger only; never any on-screen AI label/caption/watermark; exact text via native overlay; images only need to be reasonably plausible: ignore minor defects (fake text, symbols, clothing prints, small background details); regenerate at most once and only for major defects
picture.motion_engine: DaVinci Resolve editable Inspector/Fusion Zoom/Position keyframes on prepared static images (usable originals or AI 16:9 versions)
picture.motion_verification: continuous native full-shot playback and consecutive-frame inspection; sparse frames insufficient
picture.baked_in_black_bars: detect letterbox/pillarbox inside 16:9 files at 02/03 (frames or ffmpeg cropdetect); zoom = max(W/w,H/h)*1.02; apply Inspector Zoom on timeline at 05, reposition to keep subject; no stretch, no source re-render

audio.local_sound_level: audible, under VO: peaks ~-24..-18 dBFS under VO, ~-18..-12 dBFS in intro/chapter pauses (under music); short fades at cuts; disable spans with speech/music/bad noise; approximate
audio.account_note: user is signed in to their own personal account; do not check plan/subscription/linked channel/safelist/license; if it downloads, use it

delivery.final_output_folder_policy: only assigned final deliverables; no technical records, drafts or old versions

precedence: latest user instruction > existing project-specific override > defaults > historical evidence

media_sources.audio_policy: Epidemic Sound only; no silent provider fallback
sourcing_order: matching original photo via Google Images/original publisher
justified expansion or documented non-locating clause

intro.picture: all video, highlights selected from film content
intro.music: Epidemic; cultural/context fit selected per film

chapter_title.anchor: measured first VO onset of own chapter after intro/pause offsets
chapter_title.background: footage bound to that first VO sentence

claude_collab.reviewer_planner: Claude Code via Frenemy MCP 'claude' (ask_claude, read-only)

gates.C4: AI still check, major defects only: 16:9, no borders/stretch, on-topic, main subject not clearly deformed (03); minor flaws noted, not fixed
gates.C5: intro plan, cue map and chapter-title onset review (05)

claude_collab.single_writer: Codex writes all files and progress; Claude returns content only
claude_collab.cross_check: Codex runs scripts/check_claude_handoff.py and re-opens evidence before acting; Claude reviews Codex output for meaning/rules
claude_collab.on_claude_unavailable: mark gate pending_claude, continue independent work, never record as passed

text_style.animation: native in/out in DaVinci Resolve per spec; no whoosh; no other styles

ai_image_prompt_prefix.applies_to: only fully new AI images (complete regeneration, start/end images for AI video); NOT expand-only or enhance-only edits of an original; not video prompts
ai_image_prompt_prefix.position: start of prompt, verbatim, then line break

audio_track_layout.name: Local sound effect
audio_track_layout.content: audio detached from original footage; audible, volume adjusted under VO
